facts.fact: Starlink launched in Kenya in July 2023 and sells equipment and data plans to Kenyan customers (50GB plan at KES 1,300 a month, dish about KES 49,900 or rental KES 1,950 a month).
Subscribers: just over 8,000 Starlink subscribers at June 2025, per Communications Authority figures cited by the article.
Subscribers: nearly 25,000 Starlink subscribers at end of March 2026, per Communications Authority figures cited by the article.

Starlink suspended new signups in seven Kenyan counties (Nairobi, Kiambu, Mombasa, Machakos, Murang'a, Kirinyaga, Kwale) and redirected buyers to a deposit waitlist because of capacity limits; a company suspension, not a regulatory ban.
